calls.video_title: Does the Proliferation of Agentic AI Make Fortinet Stock a No Brainer? | FTNT STock Analysis
calls.price_at_call: DCF fair value $97; market price >45% above fair value; fwd P/E >46 (was ~20 entering year)
calls.thesis: Too late to buy after +121% YTD: fundamentals accelerating (op margin record 32.4%, ROIC 99.8%, agentic-AI demand) but price has run ahead of fundamentals; sideliners wait; owners trim or sell covered calls 10-20% above current price
calls.base: Fair value $97/share; market ~45%+ over fair, outside his margin of safety; most expensive valuation in years
calls.bull: Agentic-AI proliferation drives multi-year accelerating revenue growth with expanding margins; ROIC near 100% vs 10-12% WACC
calls.bear: ROIC 99.8% unsustainable; valuation de-rates if AI-demand enthusiasm fades; rogue-agent headlines have front-loaded investor interest
calls.flip_note: First tracked FTNT call on record; he was bullish since 2024 but this is the first tracked stance
